root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `igraph_read_graph_gml()` resumes the numeric node-attribute write at `VECTOR(*v)[id] = igraph_i_gml_toreal(node, j);`, the conversion call must have succeeded on the current source value; the caller must not continue the write when the helper has already taken its failure path and cleanup may have freed `v`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing path, the semantic status of the vulnerable-original call expression `igraph_i_gml_toreal(node, j)` is `IGRAPH_FAILURE` for the tree-typed `Creator` value, yet `igraph_read_graph_gml()` still resumes the numeric write and reaches the stale-pointer sink. In the authoritative fixed image the original PoC leaves that sink guarded, and the closest one-site perturbation that changes only the targeted `Creator` value from a list to a numeric literal executes the protected sink with success status 0.

nodes.state: `igraph_i_gml_destroy_attrs()` reaches `igraph_Free(value)` for the selected numeric attribute record, releasing the `igraph_vector_t` heap object that the later node-attribute write still aliases as `v`.
The numeric node-attribute write resumes at `VECTOR(*v)[id] = ...` and reads the freed `igraph_vector_t` header through stale pointer `v`, producing the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free read.

edges.relation: The same numeric vector pointer freed as `value` during cleanup is the pointer later dereferenced as `v` at the sink, so the read executes after free on the same heap object.
